narrative_passages.title: The three who were left behind

summary_for_children: At-Tawbah is about turning back to Allah, keeping our word, and being sincere. It mentions the cave where the Prophet and his companion sheltered.
environment_concept: A desert road leading back home, past a quiet cave of two and a mosque founded on righteousness.
architecture_and_scenery: Long desert road, rocky hills with a cave, a simple mosque with palm trunks and a learning circle.

areas.name: Cave of Two
areas.description: A small cave in the hills, empty and still.

areas.name: Mosque of Righteousness
areas.description: A simple mosque on firm foundations.

areas.name: Circle of Learning
areas.description: Stones in a circle where knowledge is shared.
